cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: an auction hall — rows of folding chairs, a raised wooden podium, a number paddle stand and hanging lamps
cuts.scene: she is an apprentice raising a gavel beside her face with a shaky shout to practice
cuts.outfit: an auctioneer look fitted to her body — a fitted sleeveless vest over a collared blouse and a short pencil skirt, bare arms and legs, a plain paper number tag on her vest
